import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Corresponding target column names for SalePrice from each source
    # According to target schema:
    # 'SalePrice_x' from Source0
    # 'SalePrice_y' from Source1
    # 'SalePrice_x_3' from Source2
    # 'SalePrice_y_4' from Source3
    # 'SalePrice_x_5' from Source4
    # 'SalePrice_y_6' from Source5
    # 'SalePrice_x_7' from Source6
    # 'SalePrice_y_8' from Source7
    # 'SalePrice_x_9' from Source8
    # 'SalePrice_y_10' from Source9
    target_columns = [
        "SalePrice_x",
        "SalePrice_y",
        "SalePrice_x_3",
        "SalePrice_y_4",
        "SalePrice_x_5",
        "SalePrice_y_6",
        "SalePrice_x_7",
        "SalePrice_y_8",
        "SalePrice_x_9",
        "SalePrice_y_10"
    ]

    # Load all sources into dataframes
    dfs = []
    for path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(path)
        # Drop any unnamed columns that might come from index saved in csv
        df = df.loc[:, ~df.columns.str.contains('^Unnamed')]
        dfs.append(df)

    # We will join all dataframes on 'Id' column.
    # Start from Source0 dataframe
    merged_df = dfs[0].rename(columns={"SalePrice": target_columns[0]})

    # Iteratively merge the rest on 'Id'
    for i in range(1, len(dfs)):
        df = dfs[i].rename(columns={"SalePrice": target_columns[i]})
        # Merge on 'Id' with inner join to keep only common Ids across all sources
        merged_df = pd.merge(merged_df, df, on="Id", how="inner")

    # Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
    merged_df["Id"] = merged_df["Id"].astype(int)
    for col in target_columns:
        merged_df[col] = merged_df[col].astype(float)

    # Save to target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    merged_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
